access_notes: TKDL requires authorized access for full database. Public pages provide overview information only.

key_info.description: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL) is a collaborative project between CSIR and Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India
key_info.purpose: Prevent misappropriation of Indian traditional knowledge at international patent offices
key_info.languages: Texts available in English, German, French, Japanese, Spanish
key_info.formats: Ancient texts converted into patent-compatible format
key_info.access_model: Available to patent offices internationally under access agreements; limited public access
